metadata.title: File:A Street in Paris. Study from Montmartre (Hugo Birger) - Nationalmuseum - 18854.tif

Artist.value: Hugo Birger

ImageDescription.value: Swedish artists often present Paris to us in small, sketchy excerpts from everyday life. These studies served as souvenirs for the artists themselves, but were also appreciated by collectors. The name of the street in this painting is unknown, but Hugo Birger was renting a studio together with Ernst Josephson on rue Gabrielle in Montmartre at the time.

Credit.value: Hans Thorwid / Nationalmuseum
